title: IIT Ropar Notification 2026 - Apply Online for Various Junior Research Fellow Posts
description: Indian Institute of Technology Ropar (IIT Ropar) has declared the official notification for the recruitment of various Junior Research Fellow Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in B.E/ B.Tech or M.E/ M.Tech in Chemical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering can grab this chance and apply for the IIT Ropar Notification 2026 .
